summary.en: Conan, Ayumi, Genta, and Mitsuhiko came to visit a video game company called Shining Corp, because they want to learn about the "Seven Mysteries" of the hit game Gyadorin, which will be revealed when the sequel of the game, Gyadorin Episode 2, releases the following week. Genta was suddenly in need to use the toilet, which makes him (along with Ayumi and Mitsuhiko) rush into the employee-only area uninvited, causing the company's security guard to chase them.

locations: Nobukazu Michiba's office, Shining Corp. Building
